build_swin_transformer: build a Swin Transformer model with configurable depth, attention heads, and window size for vision tasks
create_window_partition: create window partitioning that splits image features into non-overlapping local windows for efficient attention
test_window_attention: test window-based multi-head self-attention with relative position bias and optional attention masking
refactor_patch_merging: refactor patch merging to downsample feature maps by concatenating neighboring 2x2 patches and projecting
summarize_interpolate_pos_embed: summarize relative position bias interpolation that resizes pre-trained position embeddings to new image sizes
